title: Raw stage Kan-extension diagram and compatible comparison
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. Give $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^sH$ whose composites with the stage units equal the unit for $V_i$ componentwise as arrow objects. There exist a presheaf diagram $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$, morphisms $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$, and a natural transformation $\gamma:B\to\mathrm{const}(H)$ with the following properties. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$ and $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction. Each $\beta_t$ is a universal left Kan unit: composition with it bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. For all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$. Finally $\beta_t(X)\gamma_t(V_tX)=\alpha_t(X)$ for every $t,X$. No sheaf condition or isomorphism after sheafification is asserted. The universal units and their factorization equations determine these objects and maps up to compatible isomorphism.

proof.text: Construct each B_t explicitly as Mathlib leftKanExtension of the underlying stage pullback sheaf along V_t.op, and beta_t as leftKanExtensionUnit. Use V.w to transport theta_b followed by beta_tprime to the restriction along V_t.op, and define the transition by descOfIsLeftKanExtension. First prove the identity and composition equations for theta as sheaf morphisms: apply injectivity of the stage adjunction homEquiv, use htheta at objects of F(i), and transport along F.map_id, F.map_comp and Under.w. Next use the Kan factorization equations and Arrow equality under precomposition and postcomposition to transfer these two equations to the transitions B.map. Kan hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension proves map_id and map_comp. The factorization equation gives exactly the required Arrow equation for beta and B.map.

proof.text: Define delta_t explicitly by descOfIsLeftKanExtension applied to alpha_t.hom; descOfIsLeftKanExtension_fac_app gives its component factorization. For b from t to tprime, beta_t followed by B.map b and delta_tprime is a map between underlying sheaves. Regard it as a sheaf morphism and compare it with alpha_t using injectivity of the stage adjunction homEquiv. After precomposing with the stage unit, the B.map factorization, htheta, the delta_tprime factorization and halpha identify both maps with the original cocone unit. Transport endpoints with V.w, F.map_comp and Under.w; Arrow equalities can be precomposed, and postcomposed with components of a natural transformation at equal source-category objects. Thus these two sheaf morphisms agree. Kan hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension then gives B.map b followed by delta_tprime equals delta_t, proving naturality of gamma. Set gamma.app to delta; its factorization is the existing Kan lift equation. No sheaf condition or sheafification comparison is used.
